title: Tesla's Roadster Leaves the Ground
dek: Nine years after its first reveal, the car lifts off on compressed-air thrusters.
body: At a SpaceX site in Texas, it climbed an inverted ramp, rolled in midair and landed. Musk says production starts in 2028.

panels.label: Enthusiasts Say
panels.text: Commentator Carol Roth says America needs more Elon Musks, and that policy should reward that kind of risk.

panels.label: Skeptics Say
panels.text: AI scientist Yann LeCun says the demo car must be a light shell of air tanks: “Cute demo, but totally impractical.”

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: One side sees ambition, the other a marketing stunt; at stake is how far a promise may run ahead of a product.
